mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_business_outbox WHERE state IN ('PENDING','SENDING','SENT','REVIEW') ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
SELECT kind,aggregate_id FROM tb_business_outbox WHERE id=#{eventId} AND state='REVIEW'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_business_outbox SET state='PENDING',attempts=0,consume_attempts=0,next_attempt_at=NOW(),lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{eventId} AND state='REVIEW'
UPDATE tb_business_outbox SET state='PENDING',attempts=0,consume_attempts=0,next_attempt_at=NOW(),last_error=NULL WHERE idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} AND state='REVIEW'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_business_outbox WHERE id=#{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_business_outbox SET state='REVIEW',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{eventId} AND state<>'DONE'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_business_outbox WHERE (state='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=NOW()) OR (state='SENDING' AND lease_until<NOW(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_business_outbox SET state='PENDING',next_attempt_at=NOW(),sent_at=NULL WHERE state='SENT' AND sent_at<TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{sentAgeSeconds},NOW(3)) AND (deliver_at IS NULL OR deliver_at<TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{deadlineAgeSeconds},NOW(3))) ORDER BY id LIMIT 200
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_business_outbox WHERE state IN ('PENDING','SENDING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_business_outbox WHERE state='REVIEW'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_business_outbox WHERE state='SENT' AND (deliver_at IS NULL OR deliver_at<=NOW(3))
